content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments simplify the way digital creators can sell their products by utilizing blockchain technology. Unlike traditional payment platforms that impose high transaction fees and lengthy processing times, Solana enables instant transactions with minimal costs, often under $0.10 per transaction. Given that platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% per sale, which can accumulate to significant losses over time, Solana's 0.5% fee model ensures that creators retain more of their revenue. This shift not only removes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-what-nobody-tells-11|COREMERCH guide to financial]] barriers but also enhances the overall profitability for creators operating in regions where conventional payment gateways are out of reach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a Solana payment system for digital products relies on a combination of various technologies. At its core, it uses a decentralized network to process transactions, ensuring security and speed. The integration involves utilizing NOWPayments, which facilitates seamless crypto transactions and automates payment verification. Simultaneously, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can manage backend logic for product delivery and order tracking. This combination of tools creates a robust framework where products are immediately accessible upon payment confirmation, giving customers instant gratification while ensuring creators maintain full ownership and control of their sales infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is specifically designed for digital creators in developing countries, particularly where traditional payment platforms are restrictive or entirely inaccessible. This audience includes authors, course creators, graphic designers, and software developers who seek to monetize their digital products without incurring high fees or dealing with complex compliance issues. By adopting Solana payments, creators can focus on what they do best—creating—while enjoying a direct and efficient way to sell their products to a global audience without being held back by conventional payment barriers.
Retain more revenue with Solana's low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively implement Solana payments for digital products, several key components must work harmoniously. The first is a reliable hosting solution, such as Cloudflare Pages, which provides a fast and secure platform for your online store. Next is backend logic, which can be managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated order processing and product delivery. Integrating NOWPayments is crucial for handling cryptocurrency transactions smoothly. Together, these components create an ecosystem that not only supports sales but also guarantees that creators maintain full autonomy over their operations, ensuring long-term stability and growth.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start using Solana payments for your digital products, first, set up a hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages. Next, create your product listings and leverage Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated processing. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Ensure you test the payment flow to confirm that orders are processed correctly and products are delivered promptly. Finally, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details on getting started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a decentralized payment solution like Solana. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, significantly reducing transaction fees. For example, while PayPal typically charges around 2.9% plus a fixed fee, Solana payments via NOWPayments charge just 0.5%, maximizing your revenue potential.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads with minimal platform fees, adopting Solana payments is a game-changer. Explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for a comprehensive setup that includes all necessary blueprints and templates, allowing you to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. Check out https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell digital products without using PayPal?
You can sell digital products using Solana payments, which allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly. This bypasses traditional payment platforms, reducing fees and ensuring faster transactions.
What are the fees associated with Solana payments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% for each transaction processed via Solana. This is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%, allowing you to retain more revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad?
Absolutely. Using Solana payments, you can sell your templates and fonts directly from your own website, avoiding the high fees and restrictions imposed by platforms like Gumroad.
What is the best way to deliver digital products automatically?
Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital products. This ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
Is there a way to avoid platform fees entirely?
Yes. By utilizing a decentralized payment system like Solana through NOWPayments, you can conduct transactions without relying on traditional platforms that charge high fees.
